summary: D09 keeps the military tree's shape and fixes what is causally wrong or missing. Eight kept nodes get prerequisite corrections that replace non-causal or imprecise edges with the knowledge that actually enabled each weapon, all at unchanged cost (cannon_early: refined saltpetre and cast bronze OR wrought iron, not cast iron; matchlock: corned powder, not the crossbow; cannon_cast_bronze: closed-mould casting with its alloy; saddle: sewing — requests of D04, D02 and D07, accepted; trebuchet: from the new traction trebuchet, not torsion engines; composite_bow: hide glue, not birch tar; tank: rifled guns and machine guns, not cast-iron cannon; stealth: requires the aeroplane). The empty A8 of the military subtree (flintlock 1610 -> tank 1916) is filled with four causally chained nodes (rifling, breech-loading rifle, rifled breech-loading artillery, machine gun) that give the A7–A9 unit-family identities ('rifled firearms', 'rifles', 'steel guns', 'machine guns') the knowledge they presume. guided_munitions (189k RP) is split into the 1950s guided missile and precision-guided munitions, conserving workload exactly and removing the laser from the missile's closure. Two variant dead ends merge into their survivors (siege_tower -> siege_ram, crossbow_repeating -> crossbow); trace_italienne gains masonry fortification and is re-priced by the convention; the other dead ends get a realization owner (plate_armour via a PROPOSED cuirassier entity) or an explicit justification (atlatl, greek_fire, missile_defence). All unit grants remain eligibility only, realized by the M7 battle layer; five PROPOSED unit entities are an OPEN DECISION for T6.12. Net workload +48,810 RP (+0.4 %).

existing.rationale: Kept with both prerequisites corrected. Barrel metal: the first guns were cast BRONZE in China (Wuwei bronze cannon, contextually 1214–1227; Xanadu gun 1298) and forged WROUGHT-IRON staves and hoops in Europe (bombards of the Mons Meg type) — two regional material routes, hence an OR; cast-iron guns are a later development already represented by cannon_cast_iron (1543 CE), so the cast_iron edge was not causal (RESEARCHED). Propellant: the 1040s formulas (at most ~50 % saltpetre) were incendiary; a gun needs high-nitrate powder, i.e. refined saltpetre — D04's request, accepted (shift RESEARCHED by D04; the necessity of purification is INFERENCE). saltpetre_refining requires gunpowder, so it replaces the gunpowder edge. Realizes unit.artillery — consistent with bombards (siege A7).

openQuestions: OPEN DECISION (T6.12 / research content): add five inert unit entities in M6 content — unit.rangers (requires rifling), unit.line_infantry (breech_loading_rifle), unit.field_artillery (rifled_artillery), unit.machine_guns (machine_gun), unit.cuirassiers (stirrup AND plate_armour AND wheellock) — each the realizedBy of an existing unit-families.json identity (rangers 104, line_infantry 307, field_artillery 805, machine_gun_teams 408, cuirassiers 604) that has none today; or defer entity creation to M7. Recommendation: add them inert in M6 (like the 23), because M7 consumes M6's capability state and should not invent the knowledge mapping. Without them, these nodes stay valid (each has a dependant) except plate_armour, which falls back to knowledge-only.

OPEN DECISION (M7 contract, T6.12/H7): ADR-031 modernization is Age-driven and knowledge-blind, so a polity can hold by modernization an identity whose realizedBy entity it is not eligible to recruit. Which governs at recruitment — the entity's knowledge requirement or the Age realization — must be stated before unit entities become live.

Should a role be added, or should these remain knowledge inputs to M7 resolution equations (law 2: coefficients inside named equations, never free buffs)?
